agent.requirement: Implement `mapLimit<T, R>(items: T[], limit: number, worker: (item: T, index: number) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]>` that runs the async worker over items with at most `limit` workers running concurrently, and actually uses that budget when there is enough work. Return results in input order regardless of completion order. Empty input returns []; limit may exceed items.length. If a worker rejects, the returned promise rejects (never hang). If limit is not a positive integer, reject or throw.
